newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to assess Taiwan pulp mill project.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to assess Taiwan pulp mill project.

text.p: The Australian government said on Thursday the state of Tasmania had agreed to a process of environmental assessment for a proposed A$1.1 billion Taiwan Pulp and Paper Corp (TPPC) pulp mill project.
"The agreement provides for a single assessment of the likely environmental, social, economic and community effects of the project," Environment Minister Robert Hill said.
"TPPC is currently investigating the feasibility of a world-scale bleached eucalypt kraft pulp mill in northern Tasmania," Hill said in a statement.
Tasmanian Premier Tony Rundle and TPPC signed a memorandum of understanding in June to start a A$3 million feasibility study for the northern Tasmanian project, Hill said.
The agreed environmental assessment would commence after the first part of the feasibility study was completed, probably by the end of the year, he said.
The mill would consume up to two million tonnes of native eucalypt each year to produce 420,000 tonnes of pulp for paper making.
